## What does the pull request do?
Re-opened https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pull/21817 , this time, using `AttachedProperties` to represent animated composition properties.
Animations are set similar to https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pull/21817#issuecomment-5043147808 but with some changes;

```xml
<Transitions>
  <DoubleTransition Property="Opacity" Duration="0:0:0.2" Backend="Composition"/>
  <Vector3DCompositionTransition Property="(Composition.Translation)" Duration="0:0:0.4"/>
</Transitions>
```


```xml
<Style Selector="RefreshVisualizer:refreshing /template/ PathIcon#PART_Icon">
  <Style.Animations>
    <Animation Duration="0:0:0.5" IterationCount="Infinite">
      <KeyFrame Cue="0%">
          <Setter Property="(Composition.RotationAngle)"
                       Value="{Binding $parent[RefreshVisualizer].TemplateSettings.RotationStartAngle}"/>
       </KeyFrame>
      <KeyFrame Cue="100%">
          <Setter Property="(Composition.RotationAngle)"
                       Value="{Binding $parent[RefreshVisualizer].TemplateSettings.RotationEndAngle}"/>
       </KeyFrame>
    </Animation>
  </Style.Animations>
</Style>
```
Transitions that apply to composition properties have the following name format; `{Type}CompositionTransition` to differentiate from normal transitions. This is to prevent conflicts with names that are common in both normal and composition properties, like `Opacity`. An alternative would be to add a configurable property on the current transition types to differentiate between composition and normal properties, but that may cause extra maintenance load and be breaking.
